  <g>

    <path d="M287 306 C301 301 315 301 328 306" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Welcome content -->
  <text x="195" y="398" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="29" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Good food, feels like home.</text>
  <text x="195" y="428" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#F3FAF6">Discover delicious meals made with care</text>
  <text x="195" y="447" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#F3FAF6">and delivered right to your door.</text>

  <!-- Lower onboarding panel -->
  <rect x="0" y="480" width="390" height="300" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="28" y="521" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#666666">WELCOME TO HOME EATS</text>
  <text x="28" y="558" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Your next favorite meal</text>
  <text x="28" y="588" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Order homemade favorites from local</text>
  <text x="28" y="610" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">kitchens and enjoy every bite.</text>

    <text x="276" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Saved</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="345" cy="796" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="345" cy="810" rx="10" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="345" y="832" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Profile</text>
